effect.label: GCC Policy 2025 remission — legal review required

pending_verification.reason: The Maharashtra GCC Policy 2025 order can remit 50%, 75%, or 100% of duty on this instrument depending on the unit, project, zone, transaction, and policy conditions. The current calculator does not model those branches, so a possibly eligible instrument must refuse rather than return unreduced duty.

source.ref: Maharashtra R&FD Order No. Mudrank-2025/URO-31/Mudrank-2 dated 22-May-2026, pp.5-7
source.quoted_text: The order reduces or remits stamp duty under the GCC Policy 2025 for the period 3 November 2025 through 3 November 2030. Its Schedule grants 50%, 75%, or 100% relief, depending on project and zone, for Articles 6, 25, 25(da), 33, 36, 36A, 40, 54 and 60, subject to stated eligibility and anti-duplication conditions.

notes_for_reviewer: This no-op modifier is a shared eligibility gate only. A later reviewed implementation must encode the percentage, zone, project, transaction, policy-period, certificate, prior-benefit, and breach conditions before computing relief.
